Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.

Your role

Defence and security are changing fast. At Saab Naval Combat Systems, we are investing for growth and adapting to this shift. To succeed, we need to maintain focus and cohesion at system level across the solutions we deliver to our customers.
As Head of Systems Design, you will lead a department of highly skilled specialists within Technical Project Management, Systems Engineering, Configuration Management and Safety Engineering. The department is responsible for overall system design, ensuring that architecture, requirements and technical solutions are managed throughout the product lifecycle.
The organization currently consists of seven managers and their teams. You will also have a dotted-line responsibility for a team in Germany, playing a key role in strengthening collaboration and harmonizing ways of working across our Swedish and German operations. As a member of the Product Unit management team, you report to the Head of PU Combat Systems.
Your main task will be to initiate and drive a transformation journey for our Systems Design department. Today, we have many parallel projects and a strong delivery focus, but we see great potential to work more efficiently and strategically product oriented. 
Key responsibilities:
Lead, coach and develop seven line managers and their teams.
Set the strategic direction for Systems Design and translate it into clear priorities and actions.
Drive increased reuse of designs, architectures and technical solutions across projects.
Establish common processes, methods and tools within Systems Engineering, Configuration Management, Safety Engineering and Technical Project Management.
Strengthen ownership of engineering processes, methods and tools within the line organization.
Improve onboarding and knowledge sharing to reduce dependency on key individuals and accelerate productivity.
Ensure consistency and quality in the application of methods, tools and processes across projects.
Balance operational delivery with long-term capability development by acting as a bridge between projects and the line organization.
Strengthen collaboration and leverage synergies across our Swedish, German, Finnish and Australian operations.
Contribute actively to the Engineering Management Team through strategic planning, competence development and resource management.

Your profile

As a person, you are clear, trustworthy and engaging. You create participation, set direction and dare to challenge established ways of working - always with the business, the customer and your people in focus.
We believe you have:
Solid experience from systems development in a complex, regulated or safety-critical environment.
Proven leadership experience, preferably with responsibility for managers and senior experts.
Experience of driving change and improvement work in engineering organisations, for example around process development, reuse/standardisation or CM.
An understanding for or experience with running large and complex projects.
A structured and analytical working style, with the ability to see the big picture and at the same time understand operational challenges.
Strong communication and collaboration skills in English, both spoken and written. Knowledge of Swedish and/or German is an advantage but not a requirement.

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be a part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.
Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here.

Join our Technology Development team in Svedala and help develop simulation models that improve the performance of our crushing solutions. In this position, you combine analytical work with hands-on verification and testing, while building a detailed understanding of our machine systems and their functionality.  
About your job
As a CAE Engineer, you design, implement and use simulation models to support the development and optimization of our machine systems. Your work ranges from physical modelling and analysis to practical model verification, testing and measurement activities, with close connections to product development.  
Job responsibilities  
Design, implement and use simulation models across different physical domains.  
Develop functionality that supports the design, optimization and improvement of machine systems. 
Verify and validate simulation models through testing and measurement activities. 
Develop algorithms and code related to simulation and modelling.  
Collaborate with design engineers on product improvements and new concepts. 
Contribute to developing our CAE methods, tools and ways of working. 

 
Location and flexibility 
This position is based in Svedala, where Division Crushing Solutions has its global development center for crushers.
Your profile
We’re looking for someone with a strong technical and analytical foundation and an interest in physical modelling and simulation. Experience in developing and validating simulation models enables you to move confidently between theoretical analysis and practical verification.  
Your background includes 
A Master of Science or higher degree in physics, mathematics or mechanical engineering.  
Experience developing simulation models in different physical domains.  
Experience verifying and validating simulation models. 
Experience in algorithm development and coding.  
It’s beneficial if you have experience in testing, as well as experience leading projects or teams.  

You enjoy working with new technology and approaching complex challenges in a structured, analytical and pragmatic way. Collaboration comes naturally to you, and your communication skills help you work effectively across functions, cultures and with both internal and external stakeholders. Just as importantly, you contribute to a positive team spirit.  
The team
You join a small and agile Technology Development team, giving you the opportunity to influence methods, tools and ways of working within CAE. Cross-functional collaboration is a natural part of your day, connecting you with colleagues and stakeholders across our organization.
Our culture
Sandvik is so much more than an engineering group in the manufacturing industry. We’re a global company with many opportunities for personal and professional development – and great benefits. We’ve been an employer to trust for 160 years, and our reward philosophy states that remuneration and other employment conditions should align with local market practice, be competitive, and reflect responsibility and performance. We have a clear objective of being a leader within digital solutions in our industry and we focus on growing our digital customer offering. To get there, we work towards an even more diverse and inclusive organization – because we’re sure that differences improve Sandvik's business and creates a culture of innovation.

Electronics Design Engineer – MedTech
Location: Gothenburg area, Sweden
Employment: Full-time
Industry: MedTech / Medical Devices
Are you an Electronics Design Engineer looking to develop technology that makes a real difference?
We are looking for an experienced Electronics Design Engineer to join a MedTech product development team working with advanced medical devices.
In this role, you will be involved throughout the product development lifecycle – from concept, specification and architecture through design, prototyping and testing to manufacturing transfer and product support.
You will work in a highly regulated environment where technical excellence, quality, safety and reliability are critical. The role offers the opportunity to influence technical solutions and contribute to the development of products used in healthcare.
The Role
As an Electronics Design Engineer, you will be responsible for the technical design and development of electrical hardware for new products as well as improvements to existing products.
You will work closely with cross-functional teams, development partners, manufacturing, suppliers and other stakeholders to ensure that electrical designs meet technical, quality and regulatory requirements.
You will also have the opportunity to investigate new technologies and propose innovative technical solutions that address customer and product needs.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and design electrical and electronic hardware for new and existing medical products.
Participate in the complete product development lifecycle, including:
Concept development
Requirements and specifications
System and hardware architecture
Component selection
Circuit design
Prototyping
Testing and verification
Risk analysis
Manufacturing transfer
Service and product support
Plan, coordinate and execute electrical hardware development activities within projects and sub-projects.
Ensure appropriate design controls and documentation according to requirements.
Participate in technical reviews and contribute to engineering decisions.
Coordinate technical activities with development and manufacturing partners.
Design and develop robust test infrastructure to reduce dependency on hardware availability.
Investigate defects, deviations and technical issues in products and designs.
Support regulatory and quality activities and ensure requirements are properly addressed and closed.
Contribute to continuous improvement of products, processes and development methods.
Work closely with production, technical support, suppliers and sub-suppliers.
Investigate and evaluate new technologies and technical solutions.

Technical Areas
We are particularly interested in engineers with experience in one or more of the following areas:
Analog electronics and signal conditioning
A/D and D/A conversion
Digital electronics and digital design
Power electronics and power systems
RF design
FPGA and programmable logic / CPLD
EMC and electromagnetic compatibility
Hardware testing and verification

You do not need to be an expert in every area. Strong expertise in one or several of these domains is highly valuable.
Your Background
We are looking for an engineer who combines strong technical knowledge with a structured and quality-focused approach to product development.
Minimum requirements:
BSc in Electronics Engineering with at least 3 years of relevant experience, or
MSc in Electronics Engineering with at least 1 year of relevant experience, or equivalent education and experience.
Professional experience within electronics hardware development.
Experience with product development, testing and technical documentation.
Good understanding of quality, safety and regulatory considerations in product development.
Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and international teams.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication skills in English.

Experience from MedTech is a Plus
Experience from MedTech, medical devices or another highly regulated industry is particularly valuable.
Experience working according to structured development processes, design controls, risk management, verification and regulatory requirements will be considered a strong advantage.
What We Offer
This is an opportunity to work with advanced medical technology where electronics engineering has a direct impact on product performance, safety and reliability.
You will be part of an experienced engineering environment where you can:
Work with technically challenging electronics development.
Influence technical solutions and product design.
Work across the complete product development lifecycle.
Collaborate with engineers, production, suppliers and development partners.
Develop your expertise within MedTech and regulated product development.
Contribute to products with a meaningful purpose in healthcare.

Interested?
If you are an Electronics Design Engineer who wants to take the next step into MedTech and medical device development, we would be interested in hearing from you.
Apply with your CV and a short introduction about your experience and technical background.

GI Valves (HVDC) in Ludvika is now looking for a Production Supervisor that wants to engage and grow a diverse team of assemblers in our Valve production. Workplace descriptionThe projects will be performed within the Cell, Tissue and Organ Engineering group led by Dr. Paul Bourgine. Bone is a complex Organ offering structural and mechanical support of our body but also consisting in our principal hematopoietic center. The formation of Bone involves distinct stages, including cartilage, vasculature, bone and bone marrow establishment. The Bourgine lab aims at compiling human-specific knowledge on these processes, toward the development of innovative Regenerative Therapies.
Within the research group, we are committed to fostering a positive work environment characterized by respect and consideration in our relationships with one another. We continuously strive to create conditions that promote job satisfaction, professional development, and inclusion for all employees.
We are now seeking a Postdoctoral Researcher for a full-time fixed-term position, with a start date of 1st of February 2027 or by agreement.
What we offerLund University is a government agency, which means you will receive special benefits, generous annual leave, and a favorable occupational pension. Read more on the university’s website about working at Lund University: Work with us.
Duties and responsibilitiesThe Postdoctoral Researcher will work with the following tasks:
Development of novel culture systems for tissue engineering.
Isolation and differentiation of primary human cells.
Identification of cellular and molecular events throughout stages of endochondral ossification.

Other responsibilities and work tasks may also be relevant.
Eligibility requirementsTo be eligible for a postdoctoral position, you must have a PhD or a foreign degree deemed equivalent to a PhD. This requirement must be fulfilled at the time of the employment decision, and proof must be submitted by that date. Exceptions can be made in cases such as parental leave, illness, clinical duties, union commitments, or similar.
Assessment criteriaAt Lund University, postdoctoral positions are intended to provide opportunities for academic qualification. The position primarily allows for research merit, but also includes limited higher education teaching. Teaching may be included in the role. The main assessment criterion is scientific expertise in the subject area.
Required qualificationsThe position requires:
PhD in Biology or Bioengineering
Documented postdoctoral experiences in different laboratories
At least three publications as first author in a peer-reviewed journal 
Documented experience in vascular biology and engineering of vessels
Robust experience in 3D culture applied to ossification
Strong laboratory and analytical skills, with the ability to work both independently and within an interdisciplinary team.
Robust experience in culture and differentiation of human primary cells in 2D and 3D
Experience in microfluidics and microscopy
Experience in prototyping with AutoCAD
Good knowledge of English (written and spoken).

Merits include:
Experience with human mesenchymal cell culture and differentiation
Background in biomaterials science and/or polymer synthesis.
Experience with 3D printing/additive manufacturing and associated software
Experience as executive member of scientific societies 

Terms of employment
This is a fixed-term, full-time position for two years, starting on 2027-02-01 or as agreed.Employment at Lund University takes place in Sweden, and you are therefore expected to carry out your work on site in Lund.
The appointment is limited to a minimum of two years and a maximum of three years, in accordance with the collective agreement on fixed-term employment as a postdoc (Arbetsgivarverket). A postdoctoral position is intended as an initial step in a research career and an opportunity to deepen and broaden research expertise.
Application instructionsYour application should include:
A cover letter describing your interest in the project, how you meet the required qualifications (including previous independent projects and technical skills), your research interests, and your future career plans
A CV including names and contact details of two former supervisors
A complete publication list (can be included in your CV)
A copy of your diploma (PhD or equivalent)

We warmly welcome your application!
Mer om Medicinska fakulteten
Medicinska fakulteten är ett verksamhetsområde inom Lunds universitet, med ansvar för utbildning och forskning inom medicin, vård och hälsa. Utbildningen sker i nära samverkan med sjukvården och är väl förankrad i fakultetens starka forskningstradition. We are looking for a researcher in Psychology for a fixed-term position at the School of Behavioral, Social and Legal Sciences (BSR). The research is within the area of cognitive neuroscience of aging.
Subject area
The subject area for this position is Psychology.
Background
The Division of Psychology at Örebro University is part of the School of Behavioural, Social and Legal Sciences (BSR), together with the Divisions of Legal Science, Criminology, and Social Work.
Örebro university is now hiring a researcher within the area of cognitive neuroscience of aging, with a particular focus on early life predictors of brain structural and functional connectivity in older age. The research will be conducted within the research environment LEADER (Center for Lifespan Developmental Research), which is headed by Jonas Persson, Professor in Psychology.
Duties and responsibilities
The research duties include preprocessing and analyses of structural and functional brain imaging data obtained by magnetic resonance imaging. A particular focus will be on analysing diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) data to assess structural connectivity and brain network properties in older age and how these related to health, cognition, lifestyle and other factors in childhood and adolescence. Analyses of functional connectivity data from resting-state fMRI images and the relationship with early life predictors is also expected. The applicant will also have a leading role in dissemination of the results through international peer-reviewed publication and presentations.  
Qualifications
Those qualified for the appointment as a researcher are applicants who have obtained a doctoral degree or have a degree from abroad deemed to correspond to a doctoral degree.
Assessment criteria
A general basis for assessment is that the applicant is able to demonstrate the personal qualities required to successfully perform the duties and responsibilities at hand; that they are able to cooperate with other members of staff; and contribute to the development of university operations.
Specific personal abilities that are of great importance for the position is documented expertise in the fields of cognitive aging and brain imaging. Of particular importance is proficiency in analysing structural brain connectivity data, connectome-based modelling and tractography of diffusion-tensor imaging (DTI)/DWI data combined with a documented ability in analysing functional MRI data. Experience of working with longitudinal MRI data is also highly desirable, along with experience in working with software such as Matlab, R and SPM.
Information
This is a fixed-term full-time position for 12 months. At Örebro University, salary depends on the successful candidate’s qualifications and experience.
For more information about the position, contact Jonas Persson +46 19 301428, email: jonas.persson@oru.se, or Head of Unit Terese Glatz, +46 19 301205, email: terese.glatz@oru.se.
At Örebro University, we expect each member of staff to be open to development and change; take responsibility for their work and performance; demonstrate a keen interest in collaboration and contribute to development; as well as to show respect for others by adopting a constructive and professional approach.
Örebro University actively pursues equal opportunities and gender equality as well as a work environment characterised by openness, trust and respect. We value the qualities that diversity adds to our operations.
Application

For the application to be complete, the following electronic documents must be included:
Covering letter, outlining how you believe you can contribute to the continued development of Örebro University
CV with a relevant description of your overall qualifications and experience
Account of research qualifications and experience
Copies of relevant course/degree certificates and references verifying eligibility and criteria met

Only documents written in Swedish, English, Norwegian and Danish can be reviewed.

The application deadline is November 27, 2026. We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.occupation: Hydro Analyst / Dispatcher at Dispatch Nordic
jobs.description:
Company Description

Vattenfall is one of Europe’s largest producers and retailers of electricity and heat. Our main markets are Sweden, Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark, and the UK. The Vattenfall Group has approximately 21 000 employees. We have been electrifying industries, powering homes and transforming life through innovation for more than 100 years. 

Job Description

Do you want to help shape the future energy system and support the integration of more renewable electricity into the European power system? Do you enjoy real-time decision-making, programming and data analysis? Join Dispatch Nordic as a Hydro Analyst / Dispatcher and combine operational dispatch with analytical work on hydro optimisation.
Dispatch Nordic is part of Vattenfall’s Intraday Optimisation Nordic department. We optimise Vattenfall’s Nordic asset portfolio in physical power markets, contributing to a sustainable energy system. Our team focuses on innovation, performance and flexibility in a rapidly changing European power market.
Your role as Hydro Analyst / Dispatcher 
This role combines approximately 50% operational work at the Dispatch Desk in our Nordic Dispatch Centre with analytical work on hydro optimisation. In the analytical part of the role, you will support the development of optimisation and trading strategies, ancillary service delivery, and systems and tools for quantitative, data-driven decision support. You will work with data analysis, advanced forecasting tools and algorithmic trading. 
As a Dispatcher, you will work at a desk that operates around the clock in a three-shift system. The Dispatch Desk is responsible for intraday optimisation and dispatch of Vattenfall’s Nordic asset portfolio, including bidding for and delivering ancillary services, intraday trading, and operating and monitoring algorithms. Vattenfall’s Dispatch Desk plays a central role in the Swedish power system. Working at the desk will deepen your understanding of the Nordic power market and provide practical insights for your analytical work. We value creativity, initiative and a willingness to challenge established approaches. 
Combining operational and analytical work is an established and valued way of working within Business Unit Assets. It offers varied responsibilities and allows you to use operational experience to improve analytical solutions, while applying analytical insights to dispatch decisions. 
Main tasks and responsibilities 
Work as a Dispatcher in the Nordic Dispatch Centre for approximately 50% of your working time, as part of the 24/7 three-shift operation. 
Support our experts in continuously improving the optimisation of Vattenfall’s Nordic hydro portfolio, including optimisation and trading strategies, algorithmic trading and ancillary service delivery.  
Support the development and improvement of forecasting and data-driven decision-support tools for hydro optimisation. 
Evaluate existing solutions, identify opportunities for improvement and initiate changes that improve business outcomes. 

Qualifications

We are looking for someone with:
A university degree in a quantitative or financial discipline, such as Engineering, IT, Econometrics, Mathematics, Physics or a related field
Programming and data analysis skills, preferably in Python
Minimum 2–5 years of experience in the Nordic physical power market
Fluency in Swedish and a good command of English

You have a genuine interest in markets and trading and are curious about how prices are formed and how market opportunities arise. You are comfortable working in a dynamic environment where priorities can change quickly, and you can manage several activities at the same time. You bring a strong business sense and enjoy combining market understanding with data and quantitative analysis.
